# scripts/host/Publish-ProfileUnityStaging.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Runs ON the ProfileUnity console VM: hashes the compiled INI, client.net.xml and plain-text export in C:\ProgramData\avd-liquidware\deploy and uploads them to the media account's staging container with the console's managed identity.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-MediaAccountName` | string | no | `''` |  |
| `-ConfigName` | string | no | `'default'` |  |
| `-Timestamp` | string | no | `''` |  |
| `-DeployFolder` | string | no | `'C:\ProgramData\avd-liquidware\deploy'` |  |
| `-StorageSuffix` | string | no | `'core.windows.net'` |  |
